components.name: boiler_lower_shell
components.notes: One continuous eight-facet cast shell with threaded neck; do not fake facets from stacked primitives.

components.name: collector_upper_shell
components.notes: One continuous eight-facet chamber including its integrated spout transition and interior floor.

components.name: lid
components.notes: Separate hinged casting with shallow crown and underside ribs.

components.name: handle
components.notes: Thermoplastic swept grip; negative space is identity-critical.

components.name: lid_knob
components.notes: Tapered thermoplastic knob fastened through lid center.

components.name: hinge
components.notes: Metal hinge aligned above handle mount.

components.name: safety_valve
components.notes: Small machined assembly on upper boiler facet.

components.name: central_delivery_column
components.notes: Rises from collector floor and terminates below lid.

components.name: gasket_and_filter_plate
components.notes: Internal sealing/filter stack at threaded joint.

components.name: branding_and_stamps
components.notes: Surface graphics are not geometry authority and are deferred until primary accuracy.

relationships.notes: Threaded connection across the narrow waist.
Rear hinge defines one rotation axis.
Hinge barrels attach lid to collector rear.
